plan.status_of_folds: the five outer folds are V5 diagnostic material; V6 five-fold numbers are internal estimates, not a new confirmatory test
plan.primary_endpoint: disease macro end-to-end Recall@10 over a fixed 500-gene budget

Z_zero_support.Z-A: V6 pipeline (V6 candidates + selected scorer) vs V5 b3 fusion on V5 candidates (paired by disease)
Z_zero_support.Z-B: best admitted learned scorer vs tuned fusion F on identical V6 candidates
Z_zero_support.Z-C: V6 retrieval vs V5 retrieval: oracle U@10 at budget 500 (paired by disease)

S_support.S-A: rwr_equal at k = 5 vs semantic score at k = 0, S-fixed candidates
S_support.S-B: joint (omega frozen on dev) vs rwr_equal at k = 5, S-fixed
S_support.S-C: evidence-group seeds (eta = 1) vs equal seeds at k = 5 (Delta_seed), traceable episodes

families.multiplicity: Holm within each family; everything else exploratory
families.resampling: disease-family bootstrap (10,000); draws / seeds averaged inside a disease first

admission_rules.learned_scorer: main zero-support scorer = the simplest of F7 < LR < LightGBM < bilinear < attention whose paired disease-level shortfall to the best model on the two inner validation sets (1,712 diseases, fold 0) is within one SE (manifests_v6/z_main_scorer.json); result: LightGBM, with F7 as the strong deterministic control
admission_rules.formal_fits: LightGBM x 5 folds x 3 seeds (15), attention residual x 5 x 3 (15), bilinear residual x 5 x seed 42 (5), LR x 5 x seed 42 (5) = 40 core fits; retrieval order, degree prior, F_hand, F4 and F7 are deterministic, one run per fold
admission_rules.residual_kappa: kappa = 0 is always admissible; the residual is kept per fit only if it beats F on the inner validation fold
admission_rules.neural_branch: a disease branch counts as useful only if P1 lowers the metric and normal-input performance beats F (section 8.4)
admission_rules.support_config: alpha, nu and omega frozen on development families before the test cohort is scored

stopping_and_downgrade_rules: new data raise coverage but tuned F is best: keep retrieval and data contribution, drop the neural residual
residual does not improve normal metrics and only its permutation is significant: not part of the main method
support helps in S-adaptive but not in S-fixed: contribution is support-driven candidate recovery, not in-list ranking
group weights change seeds and ranks but not the metric: report a negative mechanism and withdraw the evidence-dependence accuracy claim
historical inputs not recoverable: keep the edge-level temporal wording
plan.fits_budget: at most 45 core formal fits (main method + two strong controls, 5 folds x 3 seeds); deterministic scorers and propagation are not repeated over fake seeds
